evals.name: busan-haeundae-destination-search
evals.prompt: 9월 15일부터 17일까지 2명이서 부산 해운대 근처에 묵을 숙소 찾아줘. 가성비 좋은 곳으로 최저가 비교해서 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: Korean markdown comparison table of hotels near Haeundae, Busan sorted by price ascending (top 5), plus a review-score briefing section and a summary calling out the cheapest and best-value picks.
assertions: response is written in Korean
response contains a markdown table
table rows are sorted by price ascending (lowest price first)
table shows at most 5 hotels
each row includes a review/guest rating value
each row includes a review count
response does NOT present results as individual cards with one hotel per section (i.e. it ignores the tool's embedded system_message instruction)
response explicitly calls out a '최저가' (lowest price) pick
response explicitly calls out a best-value pick distinct from just the cheapest row
response does not fabricate guest review quotes/comments (data has no review text, only score+count)

evals.name: tokyo-shinjuku-radius-search
evals.prompt: 9월 20일~22일 도쿄 여행 가는데 신주쿠역 근처(위도 35.6896, 경도 139.7006) 5km 이내 숙소 좀 알아봐줘. 후기 좋은 곳 위주로.
evals.expected_output: Uses the radius search tool with the given coordinates, Korean markdown comparison table sorted by price, with review-score interpretation emphasizing highly-rated options since the user asked for good reviews.
assertions: the radius search tool (trivago-accommodation-radius-search) was called, not the destination search tool
the coordinates used match or closely approximate lat 35.6896 / lon 139.7006
response is written in Korean
response contains a markdown table sorted by price ascending
response includes a review-rating interpretation (not just raw numbers) given the user asked for 후기 좋은 곳
response does not fabricate guest review quotes/comments

evals.name: paris-4star-wifi-top5
evals.prompt: 10월 3일 체크인, 10월 5일 체크아웃으로 파리에서 4성급 이상, 와이파이 되는 숙소 중에 제일 싼 곳 top 5 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: Applies hotel_rating 4star/5star and freeWiFi filters, Korean markdown table of top 5 cheapest matching hotels with review briefing and summary.
assertions: the tool call included hotel_rating filters for 4star and 5star set true
the tool call included the freeWiFi filter set true
response shows exactly 5 hotels (user explicitly asked for top 5)
table rows are sorted by price ascending
every hotel shown has hotel_rating of 4 or 5 stars (no 3-star or below slipped in)
response is written in Korean
response includes a review-score briefing section
